annotations.title: Fund a pool from management fees

description: Use this when the user wants an admin pool their manager funds paid out of the management fees the fund has collected for that manager. Starts the funding, with each manager’s available management fees. Returns Capital Company’s next question, or the proposed funding for the user to confirm. This call moves nothing.

team.description: The team to act on, by name, only when the user belongs to more than one team; leave it out otherwise
